Files are served from the GitHub release `models` of MikalaiKryvusha/KARTUN (the owner's variant B, 2026-10-14 22:04); every file carries its SHA-256 and size, the app refuses a download whose hash differs. `published: false` = not uploaded to the release yet. Licences: researches/03 section C. The models belong to their authors.
